name: Reina Lilou Lowchen
original_name: 玲奈・リル・レーフェン
source:
Affiliation: Luminous Academy, class 2-C
Class: Sacred Princess
Hobbies: Watching hero shows, cooking (good at French cuisine, but bad at Japanese)

The daughter of a leading and very famous game-making french company who is also a game designer and a very good programmer herself. She and [url=/c33532]Maher[/url] consider each other their rival. At first glance, one might suspect Reina to be a refined, traditional rich girl; however, in reality, she has bad misconceptions about Japan because she learned everything through anime and games.
